title: Lunar Vitality (Condition)
html:
Lunar Vitality

  • You have  22 temporary hit points. While having the temporary hit points, all incoming damage is reduced by 1.

Properties

 Stack ID: TEMPORARY_HP

 Stack priority: 22

Sources of Lunar Vitality

  •  Lunar Bestial Vitality

Conditions with the same stack ID

Conditions with the stack ID TEMPORARY_HP, only one of these can be applied at the same time:
Condition Effects
Armour of Agathys

Gained  5 × spell level temporary hit points. If hit with a melee attack, the attacker takes 5 × spell level⁠⁠Cold damage. This effect ends when the temporary hit points are lost.

Bear's Endurance
  • Has  Advantage on Constitution Checks.
  • Gain 7 Temporary Hit Points.
Dark One's Blessing
  • Gained  temporary hit points equal to its Charisma modifier and Warlock level combined.
False Life
  • Gain  7 temporary hit points plus 5 additional for each spell slot level above the first.
Gigantic Endurance
  • Gained  27 temporary hit points.
Heroic
  • Affected entity has gained  10 temporary hit points.
Heroism
  • Can't be  Frightened.
  • Receive  5 temporary hit points per turn.
Inspiring Resolve
  • Affected entity has been fortified by courageous words, granting it  temporary hit points.
Lunar Vitality
  • You have  22 temporary hit points. While having the temporary hit points, all incoming damage is reduced by 1.
Mantle of Inspiration
  • Imbued with bardic vigour and granted  5 temporary hit points. If hit with a melee attack, the attacker becomes  Charmed.
Myrkul's Gift
  • Gained  10 temporary hit points. Until it loses these temporary hit points, this creature deals an additional 1d4⁠⁠Necrotic with weapon attacks and has Resistance to ⁠Cold and ⁠Necrotic damage.
Rallied
  • The galvanising word and will of Duke Ravengard runs hot through your veins - granting you 30 temporary hit points.
Rallied
  • Granted  8 temporary hit points by a friendly combatant's rallying cry.
Refreshed
  • Hit Point maximum increased by 10 until the next Long Rest.
  • Turns into  Nauseated after a Long Rest or after  Auntie Ethel turns hostile.
Stormheart Resolve
  • This creature began  Hoarding Energy, gained  100 temporary hit points for 1 round and lost all Incapacitating Conditions after reviving itself.
Temporary Hit Points
  • Kept from death's door by a brief magical boost. Gained  10 temporary hit points.
Temporary Hit Points
  • Kept from death's door by a brief magical boost. Gained  15 temporary hit points.
Temporary Hit Points
  • Kept from death's door by a brief magical boost. Gained  3 temporary hit points.
Temporary Hit Points
  • Kept from death's door by a brief magical boost. Gained  4 temporary hit points.
Temporary Hit Points
  • Kept from death's door by a brief magical boost. Gained  2d10 temporary hit points.
Temporary Hit Points
  • Gained  Charisma modifier temporary hit points from  Bolstering Smite.
Temporary Hit Points
  • Kept from death's door by a brief magical boost. Gained  15 temporary hit points.
Temporary Hit Points
  • Affected entity has gained  Charisma modifier temporary hit points.
Temporary Hit Points
  • Elixir of Bloodlust granted you  5 temporary hit points. Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk.
Temporary Hit Points
  • Well-Liked and Well-Fortified: instead of dying, you have gained  temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier.
Temporary Hit Points
  • Gained  4 temporary hit points.
Temporary Hit Points
  • Kept from death's door by a brief magical boost. Gained  Constitution modifier temporary hit points.
Temporary Hit Points
  • Kept from death's door by a brief magical boost. Gained  8 temporary hit points.
Tharchiate Vigour
  • Granted 20 Temporary Hit Points by  The Tharchiate Codex's enervating magic.
Volatile Shield
  • Affected entity has been granted temporary hit points by an illithid. If these are removed by incoming damage, the shield bursts, possibly  Stunning nearby foes.
  • The shield only bursts after all temporary hit points have been removed. This also removes the condition.
  • When the shield bursts, enemies within 9 m (30 ft) are  Stunned for 1 turn, unless they succeed a  DC 15 Intelligence Saving Throw.
Withering Barrier
  • If the affected entity is hit with a melee attack while it still has temporary hit points, it deals 1d6⁠⁠Piercing to creatures within 3 m (10 ft).
